newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.

text.p: All months of Tokyo rubber futures closed higher on Friday, reflecting the yen's weaker sentiment against the dollar and the higher expiry price of the spot October, traders said.
The spot October expired at midday at 126.5 yen, up by 1.5 yen from the Thursday's close, with 610 lots of deliveries. The benchmark March 1997 contract ended up 4.1 yen at 139.1.

Buying from local investors emerged from the opening, due to the stronger yen against the dollar, the traders said. "Individual investors bought actively, particularly during the afternoon session," a brokerage house trader said.
